Replaces ordinary wild species
with seeded choices. Grass, caves,
surfing, fishing and other normal
methods use BST Range and
BST Similarity. Levels stay native.

Replaces opposing trainer species
using the seed and team slot.
Party size and held items stay
native. Changed species receive
valid level-up moves.

Controls how much stronger or
weaker a replacement Pokemon
can be, using its total base stats.
BST does not depend on level.
Example: BST 400 at 25% allows
replacement BSTs from 300 to 500.

Controls how likely similar BST
values are chosen from the pool.
0%: equal candidate chances.
25%: slight preference.
50%: moderate preference.
75%: strong preference.
100%: very strong preference.
Every eligible species can occur.

Separates ordinary Pokemon from
legendary and mythical Pokemon.
Legendary restrictions apply before
BST weighting and any fallback.

Randomizes eligible scripted
static species. Static capture
exemptions remain mandatory.
Roamers keep their stored species
and native story bookkeeping.

Randomizes scripted gift Pokemon,
including the three starters.
Starter previews and the granted
Pokemon use the same mapping.
Trades retain their native species.

Randomizes scripted gift Egg
species. Hatching spends no new
area opportunity. Breeding Eggs
retain their parent-derived species.

Randomizes ordinary visible and
hidden overworld pickups.
Important story items, Key Items,
HMs, TMs, fossils and orbs stay
native. NPC gifts, shops and held
items are unaffected. Quantities
and pickup flags are preserved.

Automatic creates a seed when
the run is configured. Manual lets
you edit its eight hexadecimal
digits on the Seed row. The resolved
seed is stored with the run.

The same seed, rules and data
produce the same replacements.
Ordinary battle RNG cannot change
them. A edits digits in settings;
A accepts editing and B undoes it.

Each eligible encounter reserves
one opportunity immediately.
Catching, defeating or fleeing
all spend it. With 2 or 3 chances,
repeat species do not reserve
another chance in the same area.
OFF disables area capture limits.

Previously owned evolutionary
families are duplicates, including
branching evolutions and Pokemon
that died or were released.
Duplicates spend no ordinary
chance and cannot be caught.

Shiny wild Pokemon may be caught
as bonus encounters despite dupes
or an exhausted area. They spend
no ordinary chance. This does not
change how often shinies appear.

Newly generated Pokemon only.
Original: 1/8192
Increased: 1/4096
High: 1/2048
Very High: 1/1024
Ultra High: 1/512
Independent from Shiny Clause.
Existing Pokemon are unchanged.

Gift Pokemon have their own event
record and spend no area chance.
OFF makes an eligible gift share
the ordinary area allowance.

Gift Eggs have their own event
record and spend no area chance.
OFF shares the area allowance.
Hatching never spends a chance.

A fainted owned Pokemon becomes

Revives and PC storage cannot
restore it. Its history remains
available in the Memorial.

With permadeath, losing every
usable party Pokemon ends the run,
even with living PC reserves.
This rule follows Permadeath and
cannot be disabled separately.

Gift Eggs remain a separate system.

Shows ordinary opportunities in
your current logical capture area.
A on View area attempts opens

Static and shiny bonus captures
are tracked separately.

Capture tracking not yet active.
It activates when you first obtain
a usable Poke Ball from any source,
including a shop or a field pickup.
Once active, it stays active even
when no Balls remain.

Area capture restrictions are OFF.
Wild encounters do not consume
ordinary capture opportunities.
Other enabled run systems remain
independent of this setting.

Current badges, level cap, next
cap target, trainer bonus and run
status. Progress is read from the
native save and persistent run.

Counts eligible ordinary capture
zones and their remaining chances.
Caught and failed results come
from persistent opportunity slots.
Statics and shiny bonus captures
have separate counters.

Review every known capture zone.
Current area comes first, then
visited available areas, visited
exhausted areas and other areas.
A opens the three attempt slots.

Owned Pokemon remain linked
through renaming, evolution and
PC moves. A shows original species,
origin, status and evolution history.

Review permanently exhausted
Pokemon and their nicknames,
original capture locations,
evolutions and defeat locations.
A opens the detailed history.

Separate records for statics,
legendary statics, gift Pokemon,
gift Eggs and bonus shiny catches.
A opens a category, then an event.
Repeatable events keep counters.

This saved run uses the original
linear BST preference. Its mapping
is preserved when loading this ROM.
New runs use a Gaussian mixture
for BST Similarity instead.

Choose EXP Lock or Obedience Cap.
EXP Lock is the default. This choice
is ignored when Level Cap is OFF.

Pokemon gain EXP normally.
Above the cap, they refuse entry
and switching into battle.
At the cap they remain eligible.
An active Pokemon that levels up
may finish the current battle.
If none can fight, your run ends,
even with living PC reserves.

EXP stops at the effective cap.
A capped Pokemon receives 0 EXP.
Excess EXP is discarded per Pokemon.
Others keep their normal shares.
Lost EXP is never redistributed.
Rare Candies and Day Care obey
the same cap.

Eligible party Pokemon are alive,
not Eggs and not exhausted.
In Obedience Cap mode, their level
must also be at or below the cap.
Overleveled Pokemon are not dead
and may still be stored or follow.

Only one eligible Pokemon remains!
If none can fight after a battle,
your run ends, even with living
Pokemon in PC storage.
Overleveled Pokemon are not dead.
A later badge can make them
eligible again while the run is active.

This run ended because the party
had no eligible combatants.
Living overleveled Pokemon were
not marked dead or deleted.
Living PC reserves cannot prevent
this mandatory loss condition.

This Pokemon refuses to battle!
Its level exceeds your current cap.

Original postgame event encounter.
Professor Oak in Eterna gives the
Key Items once prerequisites are met.
Statics ignore ordinary limits and
dupes. Failed attempts retain native
retry behavior and reuse one record.

Replaces ordinary wild species with seeded choices. Grass, caves, surfing, fishing and other normal methods use BST Range and BST Similarity. Levels stay native.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Replaces opposing trainer species using the seed and team slot. Party size and held items stay native. Changed species receive valid level-up moves.
Includes friendly allied NPCs. Their original levels, party structure and story identity are preserved.

Controls how much stronger or weaker a replacement Pokemon can be, using its total base stats. BST does not depend on level. Example: BST 400 at 25% allows replacement BSTs from 300 to 500.
Change by exactly 5 percentage points with LEFT/RIGHT. Stops at 10 and 75 percent. Requires a species randomizer enabled.

Controls how likely similar BST values are chosen from the pool. 0%: equal candidate chances. 25%: slight preference. 50%: moderate preference. 75%: strong preference. 100%: very strong preference. Every eligible species can occur.
Range defines eligibility. Similarity changes probability inside that pool. Steps are 5 percent, clamped from 0 to 100. All eligible species remain possible.
Requires a Wild, Trainer, Static, Gift or Egg species randomizer.

Separates ordinary Pokemon from legendary and mythical Pokemon. Legendary restrictions apply before BST weighting and any fallback.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.
Requires a Wild, Trainer, Static, Gift or Egg species randomizer.

Randomizes eligible scripted static species. Static capture exemptions remain mandatory. Roamers keep their stored species and native story bookkeeping.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Randomizes scripted gift Pokemon, including the three starters. Starter previews and the granted Pokemon use the same mapping. Trades retain their native species.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Randomizes scripted gift Egg species. Hatching spends no new area opportunity. Breeding Eggs retain their parent-derived species.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Randomizes ordinary visible and hidden overworld pickups. Important story items, Key Items, HMs, TMs, fossils and orbs stay native. NPC gifts, shops and held items are unaffected. Quantities and pickup flags are preserved.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Automatic creates a seed when the run is configured. Manual lets you edit its eight hexadecimal digits on the Seed row. The resolved seed is stored with the run.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Each eligible encounter reserves one opportunity immediately. Catching, defeating or fleeing all spend it. With 2 or 3 chances, repeat species do not reserve another chance in the same area. OFF disables area capture limits.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Previously owned evolutionary families are duplicates, including branching evolutions and Pokemon that died or were released. Duplicates spend no ordinary chance and cannot be caught.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.
Requires capture opportunities set to 1, 2 or 3.

Shiny wild Pokemon may be caught as bonus encounters despite dupes or an exhausted area. They spend no ordinary chance. This does not change how often shinies appear.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.
Requires capture opportunities set to 1, 2 or 3. Shiny Rate is independent.

Choose the shiny probability for newly generated Pokemon: Original 1/8192, Increased 1/4096, High 1/2048, Very High 1/1024 or Ultra High 1/512.
Existing Pokemon and forced shinies remain unchanged. Gender, nature and ability are preserved. Shiny Clause is independent: it controls capture exemptions, not shiny generation.

Gift Pokemon have their own event record and spend no area chance. OFF makes an eligible gift share the ordinary area allowance.
Inactive when capture opportunities are OFF. Gift events remain tracked separately.

Gift Eggs have their own event record and spend no area chance. OFF shares the area allowance. Hatching never spends a chance.
Hatching never spends an opportunity at the hatching location. Inactive when capture opportunities are OFF.

A fainted owned Pokemon becomes permanently exhausted. Healing, Revives and PC storage cannot restore it. Its history remains in the Memorial while the run lasts.
With no eligible party member, the run ends even with living PC reserves. The save is erased and run configuration opens automatically. OFF allows normal healing. Obedience can still end a run.

ON permits native breeding Eggs. OFF quarantines Egg production and collection during this run. Gift Eggs remain a separate system.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Uses the next unscaled boss ace plus your allowance, at most 100. Trainer scaling never raises it. The chosen Level Cap Mode controls EXP or battle-entry enforcement. After eight badges: Cynthia.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Choose EXP Lock or Obedience Cap. EXP Lock is the default. This choice is ignored when Level Cap is OFF.
EXP Lock discards surplus EXP per recipient without redistribution. Obedience allows EXP, but blocks above-cap entry and switches. With zero eligible party members, your run ends even with Permadeath OFF. Requires Level Caps ON.

Adds this many levels to the normal cap. It never raises a cap above level 100. Inactive when Level Cap is OFF.
Requires Level Caps ON. Adds 0 to 5 levels, in steps of one.

Adds levels to opposing trainer Pokemon based on earned badges. Wild levels remain unchanged. Link and facility battles keep their native parties.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Additional trainer levels equal badges times Levels per badge. Levels cannot exceed 100. Inactive when Trainer scaling is OFF.
Requires Trainer Scaling ON. Steps are one level per badge, from 1 to 3. Allied NPCs keep their original levels.

Includes leaders, rivals and other classified strong trainers in badge-based scaling. OFF keeps their native levels. Inactive when scaling is OFF.
Requires Trainer Scaling ON. Species randomization is independent.

Shows remaining capture chances after the native area-name popup. Repeated floors of one logical area do not repeat the notice. Tracking works even when this notification is disabled.
Use LEFT/RIGHT to adjust this option before starting. Review the complete settings before Confirm. This choice is saved with the run and cannot be changed during the adventure.

Choose a preset to initialize all settings consistently. Changing a setting makes the effective profile Custom. You can review every setting before confirming. Classic disables randomization and Nuzlocke enforcement; Following remains available.

Automatic resolves a seed for this run. Manual edits eight hexadecimal digits: LEFT/RIGHT selects a digit, UP/DOWN changes it. A accepts, B cancels. The same saved seed, settings and data version reproduce species mappings independently of ordinary battle RNG.
Review every selected setting and seed. B returns to editing. Only A on the final Confirm row starts Rowan. Closing X help never confirms the run.
